requirements.quote:
If a CNAME RRset is present at a name in a signed zone, appropriate
   RRSIG and NSEC RRsets are REQUIRED at that name.
requirements.condition: A CNAME RRset is present at a name in a signed zone.
requirements.required_behavior: An appropriate RRSIG RRset is required at that name.
requirements.why_checkable: The signed-zone contents at a CNAME owner name can be checked for an appropriate RRSIG RRset.

requirements.quote:
If a CNAME RRset is present at a name in a signed zone, appropriate
   RRSIG and NSEC RRsets are REQUIRED at that name.
requirements.condition: A CNAME RRset is present at a name in a signed zone.
requirements.required_behavior: An appropriate NSEC RRset is required at that name.
requirements.why_checkable: The signed-zone contents at a CNAME owner name can be checked for an appropriate NSEC RRset.

requirements.quote:
If a CNAME RRset is present at a name in a signed zone, appropriate
   RRSIG and NSEC RRsets are REQUIRED at that name.  A KEY RRset at that
   name for secure dynamic update purposes is also allowed ([RFC3007]).
requirements.condition: A CNAME RRset is present at a name in a signed zone, and a KEY RRset at that name is used for secure dynamic update purposes.
requirements.required_behavior: A KEY RRset is allowed at that name for secure dynamic update purposes; its presence is optional.
requirements.why_checkable: The allowed RRset combinations at a signed-zone CNAME owner name can be checked to include an optional KEY RRset for secure dynamic update.

requirements.quote:
If a CNAME RRset is present at a name in a signed zone, appropriate
   RRSIG and NSEC RRsets are REQUIRED at that name.  A KEY RRset at that
   name for secure dynamic update purposes is also allowed ([RFC3007]).
   Other types MUST NOT be present at that name.
requirements.condition: A CNAME RRset is present at a name in a signed zone.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Resource record types other than CNAME, RRSIG, NSEC, and a KEY RRset for secure dynamic update purposes must not be present at that name.
requirements.why_checkable: The RR types at a signed-zone CNAME owner name can be enumerated and checked against the permitted coexistence types and the KEY purpose condition.

requirements.quote:
a signed zone



Arends, et al.              Standards Track                     [Page 7]


RFC 4035             DNSSEC Protocol Modifications            March 2005


   requires NSEC and RRSIG RRs for every authoritative name.
requirements.condition: A name is authoritative in a signed zone.
requirements.required_behavior: NSEC RRs are required for that authoritative name.
requirements.why_checkable: The signed-zone data can be checked for NSEC RRs at each authoritative name.
